decision_conditions: The proposed side extensions by reason of excessive width, height and insufficiently set behind the main building line would fail to be subordinate to the main building and would appear unacceptably dominant and visually intrusive feature in the streetscene and rear garden environment detrimental to the visual amenity of the locality contrary to Policy 26 of the Havering Local Plan adopted 2021.

The proposed two storey side extension would, by reason of its height, bulk and proximity to the shared boundary with no.161, would result in increased overlooking and excessive loss of privacy to the occupiers of no.161 contrary to Policy 7 of the Havering Local Plan adopted 2021.

Statement Required by Article 35 (2) of the Town and Country Planning (Development Management Procedure) (England) Order 2015: Consideration was given to seeking amendments, but given conflict with adopted planning policy, it was necessary to issue a decision as close to the statutory timeframe as possible as opposed to seeking amendments which would have significantly delayed the application.
description: Two storey side extension, single storey rear extension and erection of garage
